title: usage.data_points.v1
description: Cumulative counts of stored readings per organization and UTC hour (spec 029 US3, ADR-036). Producer: runtime usage reporter (Store.ReportUsage), written to device_runtime.outbox every 60 s in the transaction that marks the buckets reported, relayed on iot.runtime.usage.data_points.v1 and posted to /api/internal/devices/events. Consumer: control plane RuntimeController, which applies only increases per bucket to billing usage (DataPointReports). At least once; deduplicate by uuid, a UUID v5 of usage.data_points#<final_through>#<sha256 of the buckets JSON>, in device_inbox. Counts are cumulative, so replays and reordering are harmless. Times are RFC 3339 UTC.

generated_at.description: When the reporter built the event.

final_through.description: Every bucket whose hour ends at or before this instant is final, across all organizations. It never moves backwards.

buckets.description: 0 to 500 buckets. An event with none still advances final_through.

hour.description: The UTC hour start, from the storage transaction's now().

count.description: The cumulative number of readings stored for the organization in that hour, not an increment.

final.description: The hour ended more than one minute before generated_at, so the count will not change.
